description: Find malformed workflow inputs silently wrapped or filtered into valid-looking steps.
failure: Unsupported scalar wrapping, silent item filtering or default repair hides malformed structured input.

lesson.applicability: Parsers and workflow ingress whose declared schema requires structured operation inputs.
lesson.cause: Implicit wrapping and filtering erase the original specification error instead of returning the declared refusal.
lesson.correction: Keep AP_PY_013 paired with HP_PY_013: refuse unsupported structure at the existing boundary and retain the offending item or index.
lesson.counterexample: A scalar becomes a fabricated nullary operation, or invalid items disappear from a mixed input collection.
lesson.evidence_excerpt: A parser, workflow runner, or ingress boundary silently accepts malformed input structures (e.g. converting a bare scalar into a nullary operation, discarding non-matching items from a mixed list, or defaulting invalid JSON/YAML keys) without emitting a typed refusal.
lesson.exceptions: Explicitly licensed normalization or filtering is permitted by its own schema; this pattern does not require every parser to share one input format.
lesson.failed_claim: A malformed scalar or mixed collection can be silently repaired into executable steps without changing caller semantics.
lesson.verification: Source bytes and the quoted owner guidance were read during this extension. repair: Use the existing structured-step validator and return its explicit typed refusal, with the input index where available; preserve valid inputs.
